data.long_meaning: The one who is quiet, calm, and patient in difficult times. The name Ajaz carries the meaning “Quiet, calm” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Ajaz usually hope their child will grow to embody quiet, calm and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ajaz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Quiet, calm.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ajaz total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
